summary: fix(settings): report wrap failures that need a fix
description:
Because:
- Some wrap failures that need an engineering fix never reached Sentry.
- A passkey with no PRF output still fetched the wrap and loaded the HPKE chunk.

This commit:
- Reports any TypeError other than a fetch network failure, tagged with its type.
- Reports a refused proof, a disabled server flag and a token/session uid mismatch.
- Skips the wrap path in the hook when the passkey returned no PRF output.
- Moves isZeroed into passkey-crypto so consumption no longer imports creation.
- Adds a test that recovers kB through the real wrap module.

Closes #FXA-13152
